svo.DetectorType_note: SVO's 2MASS/2MASS.J (captured 2025-10-11) is the same array as NJM's (SVO/NJM ratio 1.000 wherever both exceed 5 % of peak) but is labelled photon, while SVO's archived H and Ks records (2025-03-23, 2023-10-04) label the same kind of curve energy. NJM follows Cohen, Wheaton & Megeath (2003, AJ 126, 1090, §3): the RSRs 'are designed to be integrated directly over stellar spectra in Fλ form' with the wavelength factor already folded in, which is energy in SED_Tools' convention. SVO's J label is not used.

notes: The 2MASS FAQ asks for the standard acknowledgement and gives Skrutskie et al. (2006) as the 2MASS reference. The RSR page (VI.4a) calls the Cohen et al. (2003) curves photon-counting RSRs that include PLEXUS-modelled atmospheric transmission. The 2MASS FAQ separately says 2MASS Image Gallery images are public domain; licence here uses IRSA's general terms page, which covers public IRSA data. DetectorType changed to energy, DetectorTypeSource original (2026-10-26): Cohen, Wheaton & Megeath (2003) §3, quoted on the Explanatory Supplement VI.4a page, say these RSRs 'are designed to be integrated directly over stellar spectra in Fλ form' because the wavelength factor is already folded in ('The QE-based component was converted to yield photon-counting RSRs by multiplying by wavelength and renormalized'). In SED_Tools' convention that is an energy integration; NJM's earlier photon label came from SVO's 2025 relabelling of 2MASS.J and is not used.
